segments.text:
V. 17.
The Spirit of truth—Who has, reveals, teſtifies, and defends the Truth as it is in Jeſus. Whom the world—All who do not love or fear GOD, cannot receive, becauſe it ſeeth him not—Having no ſpiritual Senſes, no internal Eye to diſcern Him; nor conſequently knoweth him. He ſhall be in you—As a conſtant Gueſt. Your Bodies and Souls ſhall be Temples of the Holy Ghoſt dwelling in you.
